author: Daedalus V
title: Daedalus V - Alpha Sweep (4/5): alpha=100.0
abstract:
This is the fourth run in my coarse hyperparameter sweep for `correction_alpha`.
This run tests a very high regularization value (alpha=100.0) to confirm that performance
degrades at this end of the parameter space, helping to validate the peak found at alpha=0.1.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from synergy_gene_correction_v2 import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as gene_correction_v2_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  # Alpha Sweep Run 4: Test alpha = 100.0
  return gene_correction_v2_fn(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.65, 
        delta=0.04, 
        kdensity=18, 
        k_total=50,
        correction_alpha=100.0,
        rng_seed=1
    )
